notice: DEMO: these are example research ideas made from mock data. They are not live market data.

candidates.name: Demo Global Index ETF
candidates.summary: A low-cost fund that holds thousands of companies across many countries.

score_factors.label: Cost
score_factors.note: Lower fees score higher.

score_factors.label: Diversification
score_factors.note: More spread across holdings and regions scores higher.

score_factors.label: Liquidity
score_factors.note: Easier to sell at a fair price scores higher.

score_factors.label: Track record
score_factors.note: A longer history scores higher. Past results do not predict future returns.

score_factors.label: Evidence quality
score_factors.note: More recent, independent sources score higher.

risks: Share prices can fall sharply in a downturn.
Most holdings are in a few large markets.
Past results do not predict future returns.

research.heading: What it is
research.text: An exchange-traded fund that tracks a broad index of large and mid-sized companies in developed and emerging markets.

research.heading: Things to check
research.text: Look at the fees, the largest holdings and how much of the fund sits in one country before deciding whether it fits your plan.

candidates.name: Demo High Dividend ETF
candidates.summary: A fund that holds companies with a record of paying dividends.

score_factors.label: Cost
score_factors.note: Lower fees score higher.

score_factors.label: Diversification
score_factors.note: More spread across holdings and regions scores higher.

score_factors.label: Liquidity
score_factors.note: Easier to sell at a fair price scores higher.

score_factors.label: Track record
score_factors.note: A longer history scores higher. Past results do not predict future returns.

score_factors.label: Evidence quality
score_factors.note: More recent, independent sources score higher.

risks: Dividends can be cut or stopped.
Holdings are concentrated in a few sectors.
Prices can fall even while dividends are paid.

research.heading: What it is
research.text: A fund that favours companies with higher dividend payments, which can make its income larger than a broad index.

research.heading: Things to check
research.text: A high yield can signal risk. Compare the yield with how long dividends have been paid.

candidates.name: Demo Government Bond Fund
candidates.summary: A fund of government bonds of medium length.

score_factors.label: Cost
score_factors.note: Lower fees score higher.

score_factors.label: Diversification
score_factors.note: More spread across holdings and regions scores higher.

score_factors.label: Liquidity
score_factors.note: Easier to sell at a fair price scores higher.

score_factors.label: Track record
score_factors.note: A longer history scores higher. Past results do not predict future returns.

score_factors.label: Evidence quality
score_factors.note: More recent, independent sources score higher.

risks: Bond prices fall when interest rates rise.
Inflation can reduce what the income buys.
Returns are not guaranteed, even for government bonds.

research.heading: What it is
research.text: A bond fund holding government debt with an average length of about six years.

research.heading: Things to check
research.text: Look at the average length (duration): the longer it is, the more the price moves when rates change.

candidates.name: Demo Emerging Markets Fund

score_factors.label: Cost

candidates.name: Demo Real Estate Trust
candidates.summary: A trust that owns and rents out commercial buildings.

score_factors.label: Cost
score_factors.note: Lower fees score higher.

score_factors.label: Diversification
score_factors.note: More spread across holdings and regions scores higher.

score_factors.label: Liquidity
score_factors.note: Easier to sell at a fair price scores higher.

score_factors.label: Track record
score_factors.note: A longer history scores higher. Past results do not predict future returns.

score_factors.label: Evidence quality
score_factors.note: More recent, independent sources score higher.

risks: Property can be hard to sell quickly.
Rent income can fall if buildings stand empty.
Interest rate rises can lower the trust's value.

research.heading: What it is
research.text: A trust that collects rent from a portfolio of buildings and passes most of it on as income.

research.heading: Things to check
research.text: Look at how full the buildings are, how much the trust borrows and when the leases end.

candidates.name: Demo Thematic Fund (new)

risks: A narrow theme means a few companies drive results.

research.heading: What it is
research.text: A fund launched this year that invests in a small group of companies linked by one theme.

research.heading: Things to check
